entries.proposition: DOSE AND ROUTE, FOR THE RECORD: 2 mM Zfra4-10 in 100 microlitres of PBS, tail vein, four weekly injections starting at 10 months, with PBS as the only comparator. No vehicle-plus-scrambled-peptide arm, no dose-response, no pharmacokinetics.
entries.snippet: five 3×Tg mice received four consecutive weekly injections

entries.proposition: BLINDING AND RANDOMISATION ARE NOT MENTIONED ANYWHERE IN THIS PAPER. The strings 'blind' and 'randomi' do not occur in the fingerprinted artefact - measured by grep over the XML, 0 occurrences of each. Every behavioural and histological readout is therefore unblinded as reported.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 legend - the statistical declaration, which states the test but no allocation or masking procedure

entries.proposition: THE GROUP SIZES ARE MUTUALLY INCONSISTENT ACROSS THE PAPER. Methods state five Zfra and five sham; Figure 1A states PBS n = 6, Zfra n = 5; Figure 1B states PBS n = 12, Zfra n = 10; Figure 2 states PBS n = 3, Zfra n = 5. Four different denominators for one cohort of ten animals.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1 panels A (Acquisition, 2-h delay p = .074, 24-h delay p = .008) and B (time in target quadrant p < .001, escape latency over 4 days, swimming speed) - two groups labelled PBS and Zfra throughout, with the group sizes carried only in the legend text, where they are 6/5 for panel A and 12/10 for panel B.

entries.proposition: The statistics are computed over fields and cells, not over animals: n = 10 for tau tangles per field and n = 40 for counted neurons, in a cohort of at most ten mice. That is pseudoreplication, and it inflates every p value in the histology.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3C '# of pT181-Tau tangles per field', PBS ~13 vs Zfra ~9, p < 0.001, 'n = 10'; Fig 3D '% Reduction in intracellular pS35-TPC6A', PBS 100 vs Zfra ~40, p < 0.00001, 'n = 40'.
entries.anchor: Figure 3, panels C and D, native PMC open-access raster

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S ONLY WWOX-GENOTYPE DATUM IS ONE UNLABELLED SUPPLEMENTARY BAR CHART, AND ITS NUMBERS DO NOT REPRODUCE ITS OWN LEGEND. The legend claims the Wwox+/- memory drop exceeds 55 percent at ages 10-12 against under 50 percent for 3xTg. The figure's x-axes read 3, >10, 8, 10 months with no genotype label on any bar and no age 12 anywhere; under either assignment of the two bar pairs to the two genotypes the drops are about 43 and 13 percent (short-term) and about 52 and 33 percent (long-term). No arrangement yields 'greater than 55 percent'. There is no n per bar, no statistic and no test.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Supplementary Fig. S1: two panels, 'Short-term memory' bars at months 3 (~78), >10 (~45), 8 (~75), 10 (~65); 'Long-term memory' bars at months 3 (~87), >10 (~42), 8 (~75), 10 (~50); a red horizontal line at 50 percent and a red vertical line between the second and third bar of each panel; y-axis '% Exploration time'; no genotype appears on either axis.
